callPaths.name: Agent执行Desktop工具
callPaths.path: Agent -> ToolFacade -> ToolRegistry -> ExecutionPipeline -> PermissionBroker -> [Desktop RuntimeAdapter] -> DesktopHost
callPaths.description: Agent调用Desktop相关工具（如desktop.action.host_action）的标准路径

callPaths.name: 用户点击菜单项
callPaths.path: Electron Renderer -> IPC -> Electron Main -> HTTP API -> DesktopAPI.InvokeContributionAction -> DesktopHost.InvokeAction -> DesktopActionBridge.ExecuteAction
callPaths.description: 用户点击桌面菜单项触发的执行路径

callPaths.name: 用户点击托盘项
callPaths.path: Electron Renderer -> IPC -> Electron Main -> HTTP API -> DesktopAPI.InvokeContributionAction -> DesktopHost.InvokeAction -> DesktopActionBridge.ExecuteAction
callPaths.description: 用户点击系统托盘项触发的执行路径

callPaths.name: 全局快捷键触发
callPaths.path: Electron Global Shortcut -> Electron Main -> HTTP API -> DesktopAPI.InvokeContributionAction -> DesktopHost.InvokeAction
callPaths.description: 全局快捷键触发的桌面动作

callPaths.name: 后端进程管理
callPaths.description: 后端内部进程管理，直接调用platform/process

callPaths.name: Extension命令执行
callPaths.path: Agent -> ToolFacade -> ToolRegistry -> ExecutionPipeline -> PermissionBroker -> [Desktop RuntimeAdapter] -> DesktopHost -> DesktopActionBridge -> ExecutionPipeline -> Extension Kernel
callPaths.description: Desktop工具调用Extension命令的内部链路

callPaths.name: 导航操作
callPaths.path: Electron UI -> IPC -> DesktopAPI -> DesktopHost.InvokeAction -> DesktopActionBridge.executeNavigation
callPaths.description: 用户导航操作（打开设置/页面等）

callPaths.name: 对话框操作
callPaths.path: Electron UI -> IPC -> DesktopAPI -> DesktopHost.InvokeAction -> DesktopActionBridge.executeDialogOpen

notes: USER_DIRECT_ACTION通过HTTP API访问，不直接绕过后端权限体系
INTERNAL_RUNTIME是后端自身的管理操作，不需要经过Agent Tool链
